Container.Name: wars-relay
Container.Overview: The schmitz-wars relay: rooms, an append-only log per game, forwarding between the two players, and the exported web game served on the same origin. Never runs the simulation. Put server.ts and the exported build/web files under /mnt/user/appdata/wars-relay/ (see relay/README.md). NPM Plus proxy host: wars.schmitzplex.com -> http://[unraid ip]:8787, Websockets Support ON, no Authelia.

Config.Name: Relay port
Config.Description: The relay's HTTP + WebSocket port. NPM Plus forwards wars.schmitzplex.com here.

Config.Name: server.ts
Config.Description: The relay source (relay/server.ts from the repo). One file, no dependencies.

Config.Name: Data (rooms and logs)
Config.Description: Every room's meta.json and log.jsonl. This IS the saved games.

Config.Name: Web game
Config.Description: The exported build/web files (index.html, index.wasm, index.pck, ...), served at / on the same origin as the relay.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port the relay listens on inside the container. Keep in step with the port mapping.

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Where the relay writes rooms/ (the Data path above).

Config.Name: STATIC_DIR
Config.Description: Where the web game is served from (the Web game path above). Empty = do not serve files.
